Hello there - much thanks for delivering the Aniselle commission last year (≧ω≦)

This time, I'd like to request a fullbody+3cheebs illustration of another of my OCs, Kirmizi! She is an upbeat, talkative Dreamfarer who loves striking up a good chat any time of the day as well as being the messenger between the various Dreamfarer guilds set up in Alterra.

I would like her normal outfit and spring outfit to be featured in this work, with the spring outfit taking up 1 chibi and the full body and the normal outfit taking up 2 chibis. If her megaphone and a 湯飲み could be featured somewhere in the work, that would be splendid. As like before, I'll leave deciding on the rest of the details to you!

Spring outfit references: https://skeb.jp/@tarouoga/works/63・https://imgur.com/a/AUZL9Ps

Normal outfit references: https://imgur.com/a/KhDajrH・https://skeb.jp/@toromix2/works/37・https://skeb.jp/@Dot_mebae/works/1

Once again, much thanks for your consideration!
